method: Independent manual approximate visible endpoints from actual 48-color atlas cells and exact reference crops. Native pixel coordinates, rounded; identical stable points across breathing frames intentionally rounded identically. Projected lengths are NOT reconstructed bone lengths. Shin ratios use approved idle left shin52.8px. A ratio alone does not imply failure where pose changes projection; null never means numeric pass. Additional body landmarks supplement each sequence; concealed joints not invented.

shin.unmeasurable: Foreshortening/occlusion or damaged frame prevents a defensible stable projected shin; no numeric pass for this segment.
